research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: CYGNVS is researching systems and methods for providing continuous cybersecurity readiness using adversary AI agents that generate customized threat scenarios and digital collaboration rooms. It is also developing systems and methods for facilitating tabletop exercises using collaboration environments, systems for securely tracking incident data and automatically generating data incident reports, and systems and methods for providing secure access to collaboration rooms with dynamic tenancy. Together these efforts focus on cyber crisis simulation, response management, and secure collaboration.

identifier.value: CYGNVS Cybersecurity Incident Response Management (CIRM) Platform

product.name: CYGNVS Cybersecurity Incident Response Management (CIRM) Platform
product.description: An out-of-band platform for preparing, practicing, coordinating, documenting, and reporting major cyber incidents across security, business, legal, executive, and external response teams.

product.name: CYGNVS AI Incident Command Center
product.description: An out-of-band environment for preparing, practicing, responding to, and reporting incidents caused by organizational AI systems, including bias, hallucinations, data leakage, prompt injection, and autonomous-agent failures.

product.name: CISO Liability Insurance
product.description: An AIG-underwritten Side A D&O liability policy included with eligible CYGNVS Premium and Elite subscriptions to provide personal coverage for designated technology executives during cyber crises.
